takes.h: Clive Barker curates Compositions of the Dead, a soundtrack for Library of the Dead
takes.p: Dread Central reports that Clive Barker is curating an original soundtrack composed for his three-book Library of the Dead anthology. Kickstarter backers receive a digital download, and a limited-edition vinyl album is planned. Composers are not yet confirmed. The team hopes to deliver the music before the first book arrives in early 2027.

takes.h: A 1408 sequel is in development, with Natalia Dyer and Elijah Wood
takes.p: Dread Central, citing Variety, reports that Natalia Dyer will lead a sequel to the Stephen King adaptation 1408, with Elijah Wood in a supporting role. Mikael Håfström returns to direct a script he co-wrote with Mark Verheiden. John Cusack and Samuel L. Jackson are negotiating returns; production is slated for the first quarter of 2027.

takes.h: Super7’s Godzilla vs. Mechagodzilla ReAction two-pack arrives as a Ross exclusive
takes.p: The Toyark reports that Super7’s Godzilla ReAction Figure 2-Pack, part of its Epic Battle Series, pairs Godzilla and Mechagodzilla from the 1974 film Godzilla vs. Mechagodzilla. The 3.75-inch-scale set was listed as available exclusively at Ross stores when The Toyark posted it on November 5.

takes.h: David Del Valle, historian of horror films, dies at 77
takes.p: The Hollywood Reporter reports that David Del Valle died Wednesday, November 4, in Burbank. He produced and hosted the cable interview series Sinister Image, including a 1987 interview with Vincent Price, wrote Lost Horizons Beneath the Hollywood Sign and Six Reels Under, and recorded disc commentaries for labels including Criterion and Severin.

takes.h: Joe Hill announces Hunger, a ghost novel set in Boston in 1776
takes.p: Joe Hill’s November 5 newsletter describes Hunger as a novel set in Boston in the winter of 1776, where a ghost feeds on colonists loyal to the Crown and Captain Amos Crowe is ordered to expel it. Hill calls it “something of a return to pieces like Heart-Shaped Box.” It is due in June 2027.

takes.h: Clive Barker receives the World Fantasy Award for Life Achievement
takes.p: Clive Barker shared the 2026 World Fantasy Award for Life Achievement with Joyce Carol Oates, SF Crowsnest reports. The awards were presented on Sunday, October 25, at the World Fantasy Convention in Oakland, California. M. R. Carey’s Once Was Willem won Best Novel.

takes.h: Mezco’s One:12 Collective Michael Myers from Rob Zombie’s Halloween
takes.p: Mezco opened pre-orders for a One:12 Collective Michael Myers from Rob Zombie’s 2007 Halloween, with release listed for summer 2027, The Toyark reported October 27. The figure, about 17 cm tall, has three head portraits, nine hands, two knives, a loose mask, a jack-o’-lantern and a tombstone inscribed “Myers.”
